locations.name: Mountain Base
locations.description: You stand at the base of a tall, snow-capped mountain. A trail winds its way up to the peak.

locations.name: Mountain Peak
locations.description: You have reached the peak of the mountain. The view from here is breathtaking. To the north, you see a dense forest.

locations.name: Dense Forest
locations.description: Tall, dark trees surround you. The sounds of wildlife echo all around. There's a path that leads deeper into the woods.

locations.name: Forest Clearing
locations.description: You come across a clearing in the forest. In the center is a calm, serene pond reflecting the clear sky.
